content.summary: Santa Clara, California-based SiTime is discussing the terms of a potential deal for the Renesas division, which manufactures the clocks that synchronize the signals in wireless infrastructure, networking and data centers, the people said.  A representative for SiTime didn’t respond to requests for comment, while a Renesas spokesperson declined to comment.
